description: This file defines a Kotlin class named 'PermissionRequester' which manages runtime permission requests within an Android application. It handles requesting permissions, showing rationale dialogs, navigating to app settings, and coordinating permission result handling asynchronously.

classes.name: PermissionRequester
classes.description: A class that manages permission requests in an Android activity, including showing rationales, launching permission dialogs, and navigating to settings.

methods.name: requestIfMissing
methods.description: Requests specified permissions if they are not already granted, with optional timeout, and handles rationale presentation and settings redirection.

methods.name: showRationaleDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog explaining why permissions are needed, pausing execution until user responds.

methods.name: showSettingsDialog
methods.description: Shows a dialog prompting the user to enable permissions in app settings, with navigation to settings if confirmed.

methods.name: buildRationaleMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message explaining why certain permissions are needed.

methods.name: buildSettingsMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message instructing user to enable permissions in Android settings.

methods.name: permissionLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given permission string.
